system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 17. 3 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (22 seconds, code score 0.64) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (gruff, low): "For what?"
[b01] JULIANA (trembling, heartfelt): "For standing between me and those men."
[b02] ALEXANDER (unwavering, firm): "I would do it again."
[b03] JULIANA (whispering, awed): "Even if there were ten of them?"
[b04] ALEXANDER (deep, resolute): "As long as I draw breath..."
[b05] ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.
[b06] ALEXANDER (gentle, vowing): "...no one will hurt you again."
[b07] JULIANA (choked up, pained): "You cannot promise that."
[b08] ALEXANDER (quiet, absolute): "I just did."
[b09] ACTION: Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.

--- WINDOW 1 (29 seconds, code score 0.53) ---
[b00] JULIANA (choked up, pained): "You cannot promise that."
[b01] ALEXANDER (quiet, absolute): "I just did."
[b02] ACTION: Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
[b03] ACTION: Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
[b04] JULIANA (tender, reproachful): "You were bleeding last night."
[b05] ALEXANDER (quiet, fond): "So were you."
[b06] JULIANA (softly teasing): "You make it very difficult to argue with you."
[b07] ACTION: Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.
[b08] JULIANA (vulnerable, sincere): "I was frightened."
[b09] ALEXANDER (questioning): "Of them?"
[b10] JULIANA (whispering, earnest): "Of losing you."

--- WINDOW 2 (60 seconds, code score 0.51) ---
[b00] JULIANA (vulnerable, sincere): "I was frightened."
[b01] ALEXANDER (questioning): "Of them?"
[b02] JULIANA (whispering, earnest): "Of losing you."
[b03] ACTION: Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest, closing her eyes as his strong arms wrap around her shoulders, holding her safe against his frame.
[b04] ACTION: Juliana nestles deeper into his coat, listening intently to the rapid thudding beneath his chest.
[b05] JULIANA (soft, playful): "Your heart is racing."
[b06] ALEXANDER (warm, whispering): "So is yours."
[b07] ACTION: Juliana slowly raises her hand, gently twirling a lock of Alexander's long, unruly dark hair between her fingers.
[b08] JULIANA (lighthearted, teasing): "This is becoming impossible."
[b09] JULIANA (smiling): "Soon birds will start nesting in it."
[b10] ALEXANDER (dry, amused): "They have not complained yet."
[b11] ACTION: Juliana lets out a quiet, melodic laugh.
[b12] JULIANA (charming, tender): "Then I shall have to save you from the birds."
[b13] ACTION: Alexander gently catches her wrist mid-air, holding her hand firmly against his chest while looking into her eyes with solemn sincerity.
[b14] ALEXANDER (solemn, gentle): "Not yet."
[b15] JULIANA (sweet, reassuring): "Then I will wait."
[b16] ACTION: Juliana rests her head against Alexander's collarbone once more, wrapping both arms around him as he cradles her head in his palm.
[b17] JULIANA (reflective, resonant): "I know almost nothing about the man I married."
[b18] JULIANA (deeply moved, loving): "But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him."
[b19] SFX: Warm crackle of embers in the hearth blending with swelling, tender orchestral strings holding into the fade-out.

Pick the single best promo.
